subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given word.

Ambiguous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Uncertain or open to interpretation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ambiguous"** means something that is unclear or open to multiple interpretations; it lacks definite meaning or certainty. (अस्पष्ट या संदिग्ध)
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were ambiguous, leaving the team confused about what to do next.
 
 
 
• **"Uncertain or open to interpretation" **refers to situations, words, or actions that can have more than one meaning or lack clarity. (अस्पष्टता या विभिन्न व्याख्या के लिए खुला)
 
 
• **Example:** His statement about the upcoming project was uncertain, leading to different interpretations among the team members.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "Ambiguous" aligns most closely with the meaning "Uncertain or open to interpretation."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Funny and humorous** (मजेदार और हास्यपूर्ण): Something that is amusing or causes laughter.
 
 
• **Example:** His funny and humorous jokes always lighten the mood during meetings.
 
 
 
• **Harsh and severe** (कठोर और गंभीर): Something that is extremely strict or unpleasant.
 
 
• **Example:** The harsh and severe weather conditions made it impossible to go outside.
 
 
 
• **Clear and straightforward** (स्पष्ट और सीधे): Something that is easy to understand and not confusing.
 
 
• **Example:** The manual provided clear and straightforward instructions for assembling the furniture.
 
 

34:T952,

The correct answer is **option 2.**
